title: Concept: Dependency installed from a plain tarball URL
description: package.json declares a dependency URL that points at a tarball outside the configured registry, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The tarball is fetched without a registry signature or provenance attestation, and the URL can serve different bytes on every install.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The tarball is fetched without a registry signature or provenance attestation, and the URL can serve different bytes on every install.
